name: @pipeworx/mcp-california-jury-instructions

tools.name: caci_lookup
tools.description: Get the OFFICIAL text of a California Civil Jury Instruction (CACI) by number — e.g. "303" (Breach of Contract—Essential Factual Elements) or a verdict form like "VF-303". As adopted by the Judicial Council of California, current edition by default. Returns the instruction text (with bracketed/optional language as published), Directions for Use, Sources and Authority, Secondary Sources, and the revision history line ("New ...; Revised ..."). A revoked or reserved number returns status "revoked_or_reserved" with no text rather than a not-found error. ADOPTED text only — proposed revisions open for public comment are not covered. Pass `edition` (a prior year, e.g. a trial that occurred under an older instruction) to get that edition's text for instructions the Council flagged as changed since — only a bounded set of prior-year deltas is available (see ca_ji_editions), not a full archive. Use for "what is the official jury instruction for breach of contract" or to check the elements/Sources and Authority a civil claim instruction cites. Keyless.

number.description: CACI instruction or verdict-form number, e.g. "303", "CACI No. 303", or "VF-303".

edition.description: Optional: a prior edition year (e.g. "2025") instead of the current edition. Only available where this pack has baked a delta for that number — call ca_ji_editions to see what is available.

tools.name: calcrim_lookup
tools.description: Get the OFFICIAL text of a California Criminal Jury Instruction (CALCRIM) by number — e.g. "200" (Duties of Judge and Jury) or a verdict form like "VF-200". As adopted by the Judicial Council of California, current edition only — CALCRIM has no prior-edition delta baked (unlike caci_lookup's `edition` param; see ca_ji_editions for archived CALCRIM PDF links instead). Returns the instruction text (with bracketed/optional language as published), Bench Notes (incl. Instructional Duty), Authority, Related Issues, Secondary Sources, Commentary where present, and the revision history line. A revoked or reserved number returns status "revoked_or_reserved" with no text rather than a not-found error. ADOPTED text only — proposed revisions open for public comment are not covered. Use for "what is the official jury instruction for first-degree murder" or to check a criminal charge instruction's elements/Authority. Keyless.

number.description: CALCRIM instruction or verdict-form number, e.g. "200", "CALCRIM No. 200", or "VF-200".

edition.description: Optional. Any value other than the current edition year returns a clear "not available" response — no CALCRIM prior-edition text is baked.

tools.name: ca_ji_search
tools.description: Find the official California jury instruction NUMBER for a claim, cause of action, or criminal charge by keyword — "breach of contract" -> CACI No. 303; "first degree murder" -> a CALCRIM number; "self-defense", "negligence", "false imprisonment". Searches official instruction/verdict-form TITLES and series names across CACI (civil), CALCRIM (criminal), or both. Returns matching numbers/titles — call caci_lookup or calcrim_lookup with a number for the full text. This is a title search, not full-text search over instruction bodies. Keyless.

query.description: Claim, cause of action, or charge, e.g. "breach of contract" or "first degree murder".

limit.description: Max results to return, default 10, max 25.

tools.name: ca_ji_whats_new
tools.description: Which CACI (civil) and/or CALCRIM (criminal) jury instructions are NEW or REVISED in an edition, aggregated in one call — e.g. "what's new in the 2026 CALCRIM edition" -> CALCRIM No. 1808 (Organized Retail Theft), 3235, 3238, 3459. For CACI this is the Judicial Council's own "Table of New and Revised CACI" front-matter list for that edition; for CALCRIM (which carries no equivalent table) it is derived from each instruction's own revision-history line matched against that edition's adoption date. Only the CURRENT edition is available (see ca_ji_editions for archived editions). Withdrawn/revoked numbers are not datable from this index and are always returned empty with a note — use caci_lookup/calcrim_lookup on a specific number to check revocation status. Keyless.

edition.description: Optional edition year, e.g. "2026". Defaults to the current edition; any other year returns a clear "not available" response.

tools.name: ca_ji_editions
tools.description: List the CURRENT edition year/adoption date and ARCHIVED edition PDF links for CACI (civil) and/or CALCRIM (criminal) jury instructions. Use when a caller needs a past year's edition (e.g. for a trial that occurred under an older version) or just wants to confirm which edition caci_lookup/calcrim_lookup text comes from. Archived editions are LINKED, not text-extracted — only the current edition's instruction text is available via caci_lookup/calcrim_lookup. Keyless.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-california-jury-instructions forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the california-jury-instructions pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
